description: Replaces the monitors a status page shows, in order, each optionally in a named group ("API", "EU region"); a group sits where its first monitor is and shows their worst state. Every plan. Free.

components.description: The monitors the page shows, in order, each once. Leave out to change only the groups' settings.

display_name.description: The name visitors see; the monitor's own name by default.

group.description: The name of the group it is shown in, or null for none. Monitors with the same name form a group.

groups.description: Groups' settings by name: collapsed, and id (from list_status_pages) to rename a group and keep its badges working.

collapsed.description: Folded on the page while everything in it is operational (true by default); visitors open and fold it either way.

id.description: The group's ID, to rename it.

name: update_status_page_components
title: Change a status page's monitors and groups
